guide_used_in_prompts:
1. chay: vegetarian or vegan food, or a vegetarian restaurant (quán chay)
2. banh_mi: bánh mì
3. pho_mi_mien: phở, mì, miến and other noodle dishes (bún, hủ tiếu, bánh canh)
4. com: rice dishes (cơm tấm, cơm gà, cơm văn phòng)
5. do_an_nhanh: fast food (fried chicken, burgers, fries, hot dogs)
6. pizza: pizza
7. tra: tea and tea drinks (trà sữa, trà trái cây)
8. cafe: coffee and coffee shops
9. hai_san: seafood (ốc, cua, tôm, cá)
10. quan_nuong: barbecue and grilled food
11. quan_han: Korean food
12. quan_nhat: Japanese food
13. quoc_te: other international food (Thai, Chinese, Western, Indian and so on)
14. other: none of the above (for example lẩu or chè)
